body: Measured refinement to open request msg-01M1D9GTEPKSN2ADBT8RKC5P9Y: option B does not avoid all ten extra infer-call files. Three deliberately erase the concrete model type and therefore still require explicit SupportBasis or a helper signature change: align GateProofSuite.scala, PopulationSuite.scala, and WorkedExampleSuite.scala. The other seven use a statically concrete DefaultLocalCostModel and can remain source-compatible through a trusted default-only overload. Thus the exact choices are A: original 7 plus all 10 = 17 added paths for explicit basis everywhere; or B: original 7 plus those 3 = 10 added paths, with explicit basis for LocalCostModel and a concrete DefaultLocalCostModel overload deriving from its final weights. GraphHsmm.ablationUngated has one caller, already in WorkedExampleSuite. No path edit made.
